crossRefs.note: Listen, sons, to a father’s instruction. Pay attention and know understanding;
Now therefore, my sons, listen to me. Don’t depart from the words of my mouth.
“Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways.
Hear instruction, and be wise. Don’t refuse it.
I don’t write these things to shame you, but to admonish you as my beloved children.

translations.web: Now therefore, sons, listen to me. Pay attention to the words of my mouth.
translations.bsb: Now, my sons, listen to me, and attend to the words of my mouth.
translations.kjv: Hearken unto me now therefore, O ye children, and attend to the words of my mouth.
translations.asv: Now therefore, my sons, hearken unto me, And attend to the words of my mouth.
